body:
Founder real-time: build in the k8s operator pattern primitives. decide-action (real four-way reconciliation decision), backoff-seconds/pow2 (exponential backoff), result-for-action (real ReconcileResult + requeue policy) -- modeled on controller-runtime's own real Reconcile contract. Verified end-to-end via a real C test harness. decide-action alone dual-compiles through burrow's Go target too. PARENA commit 28db76a.

⚓ ☃
title: stdlib/k8s/operator.prn — real Kubernetes operator-pattern primitives
